callouts.html: Billing through 2026-06-26. Calendar H1 is €236k vs €262k (-10.0%). Commercial in that window is -14.0%. Credit notes are not sales.
Q1 billing is -40.6% (€76k vs €128k). H1 is milder at -10.0% — later months recovered some of the hole. There is no official sales cut on file for this distributor.
Warranty is 19.7% of calendar 2025 billed euro — not the majority of the book. Commercial 2023→2025 is +5.1% (€400k → €394k → €420k).
July this year is not in the billing file yet, so July cannot be split. Do not read an official July miss from this pack.
